name: InitLoadProgress
evidence: zeroes five fields and copies four colour words into 0x14..0x20

name: BeginLoadProgress
evidence: zeroes the five counters of a load progress record; the startup loading calls it after InitLoadProgress, before running the initialisers

name: UpdateLoadProgress
evidence: on the first call stores the total, then counts repeats of the same value and redraws the bar with DrawLoadProgressBar

name: EndLoadProgress
evidence: zeroes the five counters of a load progress record again; the startup loading calls it after the last UpdateLoadProgress

name: DrawLoadProgressBar
evidence: scales the width and fill to the bar and draws two rectangles in the colours chosen by the count

name: GetMenuChoiceLabel
evidence: returns the string D_0026A068 (g_menuChoiceLabels) holds at index

name: FormatGameSummary
evidence: formats "%d%% - %s - %d:%02d" from a percentage, a name and the clock in minutes and seconds

name: FindObject42CStateWalker
evidence: finds the first object with id 0x42C (kind 5) in g_currentWorld and returns its word +0x48, else 0; ActivatePauseMenuSelection reads its state walker's current key (GetStateWalkerCurrentKey) and BuildPauseMenuPage calls it too

name: BuildPauseMenuPage
evidence: fills the pause menu's current page (g_pauseMenuPages): its title and choice labels (g_menuChoiceLabels, CopyString, FormatToString), the game summary (FormatGameSummary) and the memory card's state; SetPauseMenuMode, SetPauseMenuPage and ActivatePauseMenuSelection call it

name: InitPauseMenu
evidence: slot 0 of the pause menu: runs the base initialiser, sets page and stage to -1, the three wanted pages to -1 and fade to 1.0

name: ChangePauseMenuPage
evidence: when the page changes, stops the sound, hides the displays of the old page and sets up those of the new one by the page number

name: SetPauseMenuOpen
evidence: opens or closes the pause menu: plays the menu change on D_00275BC0, changes page, calls slot 14 or 15 and sets open

name: ExitLevelFromPauseMenu
evidence: ActivatePauseMenuSelection calls it: clears the menu's layer page, then starts a screen fade (D_00275B04) or, without the flag, sets the pair controller 0x5F to state 6 (level key 0x106) or calls func_001F4408

name: StartPauseMenuExitFade
evidence: starts the screen fade (StartScreenFade, kind 1) to the entry D_00247AB0 that ResetGameSessionAndFade also fades to; the pause menu calls it when a save of stage 2 ends well and on leaving

name: UpdatePauseMenu
evidence: shows or hides the four pause-menu layers by the level key 0x19D8/0x19DC and the page, moves the selection with the pad's vertical or horizontal step, and on buttons 0x810, 0x80 and 0x40 runs CancelPauseMenuPage, SetPauseMenuLayerPage or ActivatePauseMenuSelection

name: SetPauseMenuLayerPage
evidence: stores the page layer idx asks for, takes the last set of the three, and changes to it at once or queues it while sliding

name: SetPauseMenuMode
evidence: slot 16 of the pause menu: moves to a queued page when the mode reaches 0, then calls the base mode setter func_001AA998

name: ShowPauseMenu
evidence: slot 14 of the pause menu: calls the base show unless it is in mode 3 with a page queued

name: HidePauseMenu
evidence: slot 15 of the pause menu: in mode 3 with a page queued drops the queue, else calls the base hide

name: DrawPauseMenu
evidence: slot 9 of the pause menu: draws the page's title and rows from the table at D_00269D50 with a pulse and the fade colour

name: SetPauseMenuPage
evidence: stores the page and, unless it is -1, calls func_001936A0

name: ActivatePauseMenuSelection
evidence: reads the chosen row of the page's table and acts on it by page and item

name: CancelPauseMenuPage
evidence: goes back from the page: sets the layer's page to -1, 0 or 0x17 by the current page number

name: ConstructMenuBoxStyle
evidence: the file's static initialiser: builds the style of the menu's box, the 0x1C-byte record D_0026A210 that the menu's element installs as its frame

name: ConstructMenuBoxStyleAtStartup
evidence: the file's _GLOBAL_$I$: calls ConstructMenuBoxStyle with (1, 0xFFFF); an entry of the startup init-list D_0027B130
